hypothesis: Truthful motion history helps under stationary dynamics but becomes a causally harmful stale prior immediately after abrupt regime changes.

change_detector.primary_source: explicit commanded segment when current_segment_idx exists; otherwise simulator-kinematic fallback

gates.A_full_equivalence: Run one L1 task x 5 seeds with official adapter and diagnostic FULL. If exact action equivalence is unavailable because the official adapter is stochastic, label diagnostic FULL as paired_full and require no systematic SR/MS discrepancy.
gates.B_event_coverage: On 3 L3 tasks x 10 FULL seeds, at least 70% of episodes must contain >=1 eligible pre-grasp abrupt change before first grasp/contact.
gates.C_primary_interaction: [(RESET_CHANGE-FULL)_L3 - (RESET_CHANGE-FULL)_L1] > 0 on paired MS with 95% CI excluding 0 for the expanded pilot; decisive smoke may proceed on positive point estimate plus consistent task-level sign.
gates.C_l3_gain: RESET_CHANGE-FULL > 0 on L3 MS; RANDOM_RESET must not reproduce the reset gain.
gates.D_local_ordering: For lower-is-better post-change distance AUC/recovery lag, RESET_CHANGE < FULL < STALE_HOLD is the expected mechanism ordering.

stop_rules: Stop if L3 event coverage is <70% after task selection/source audit.
Stop the stale-motion-prior hypothesis if there is no positive L1-vs-L3 RESET interaction.
Do not train a gate, LoRA, TTT, KV editor, or new motion encoder until Gate C survives.
Do not run flow-only/kinematics-only/history-length/severity sweeps until Gate C survives.
